description: This source file defines the 'ChannelId' struct and the 'InternalChannelId' struct, which are used to identify and manage channels within the Orleans.BroadcastChannel provider. It includes methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and formatting of channel identifiers.

classes.name: ChannelId
classes.description: Implements a unique identifier for a broadcast channel, including namespace, key, and hash computations. Supports comparison, serialization, and formatting.

classes.name: InternalChannelId
classes.description: Internal struct combining a ChannelId with a provider name for internal management and link to external provider contexts.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating ChannelId instances from spans, GUIDs, or strings.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this ChannelId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the ChannelId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ChannelId.
